slides.headline: Free plugin, paid models
body: The plugin installs free in Hermes Agent, the open-source AI assistant from Nous Research.
Generating models needs a paid Meshy plan and uses credits. You approve the cost before each job.
slides.take: The hard part of AI models has always been the cleanup before printing. If the repair step holds up, that’s the real story.
